item.title: TorchTPU is now open source: Run native PyTorch on TPUs
item.description: Today at PyTorch Conference 2026, we announced a range of new products and integrations designed to help you run PyTorch effectively on Google Cloud or in your own infrastructure. Notably, TorchTPU, our native PyTorch stack for Google TPUs, is now available as open source on GitHub. With TorchTPU, TPUs join GPUs and CPUs as a native option for PyTorch. You can now train, serve, and deploy models on TPUs using the tools you already rely on, including vLLM, SGLang, llm-d, TorchTitan, Ray, TorchRec — Google Cloud Blog / score: 75 (PyTorchのTPUネイティブ対応オープンソース化)

item.title: Announcing llm-d 1.0: Open distributed inference for agents on Google Cloud TPUs and GPUs
item.description: Today at the PyTorch Conference, we released llm-d 1.0, an open-source, Kubernetes-native stack for distributed LLM inference.
